cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Furniture announces location, not succession.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please. I already agree.
